name: qos-harvest-memory
description: Summarise decisions, glossary, and follow-ups into .qos/memory.
prompt: Read relevant specs, tasks, and recent changes under .qos/specs, .qos/tasks, and the repo. Summarise: (1) key decisions, (2) glossary of terms, (3) follow-ups and risks. Write or update files under .qos/memory (e.g., decisions.md, glossary.md, follow-ups.md). Call out where steering docs (.kiro/steering) should be updated and propose concrete edits.
